title: Lockfile written in the legacy v1 format
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile in the legacy v1 format, which records a weaker per-package provenance shape. The old format records less provenance per package, so the review sees a weaker graph than a modern lockfile would give it.
remediation: Regenerate the lockfile with a current npm release and commit the v2/v3 result.
limitation: It matches a lockfile in the legacy v1 format, which records a weaker per-package provenance shape in the parsed package-lock.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
